title: PipelineMetadata
description: The per-page JSON record written beside one rendered page's artifacts (FR-047). The field list is the union of FR-047's minimum fields, FR-047's required run provenance, and the per-region entry FR-047 defines. Every field is deterministic across runs given identical inputs and configuration, except stage_timings and the per-region elapsed fields, which are excluded from the byte-wise determinism comparison (research R8). No field may ever hold an API key or any secret material (FR-035).

image_id.description: <manga>/<NNN>, quoted from the Spec 1 manifest. Never constructed and never renumbered (FR-001).

run_id.description: The run this page belongs to. The run's only time-identifying value; no wall-clock timestamp appears anywhere else in this file (research R8).

segmentation_method.description: The four FR-009 identities. Fixed for the whole run; never mixed within one run's per-page results (FR-011).

inpainting_method.description: The Spec 3 inpainting source this page was rendered onto (FR-004, FR-012).

run_id.description: The Spec 3 run ID. Fixed for the whole run (FR-049).

algorithm.description: The Spec 3 algorithm directory name. Fixed for the whole run.

radius.description: Quoted from Spec 3's sidecar, not recomputed (FR-004).

dilation_enabled.description: Quoted from Spec 3's sidecar, not recomputed.

target_language.description: At minimum Vietnamese and English (FR-030). Fixed for the whole run (FR-049).

ocr_engine.description: Engine identity and version, recorded per run as well as per result (FR-022).

deterministic.description: The provider's determinism, recorded as a provider property (FR-058). False keeps the determinism comparison from spanning the translation stage.

secret_env_var.description: The NAME of the environment variable the provider needs, never its value (FR-034, FR-035).

translation_provider.description: Provider/model/version, recorded for every run (FR-035, SC-004).

font_path.description: Resolved by file path from configuration, never by system font lookup (FR-039, research R6).

rendering_config.description: The rendering configuration actually used, recorded per run (FR-039, FR-047).

regions.description: One entry per extracted region, including failed ones (FR-031). Empty when the page yielded no regions, which is a recorded outcome and not a run failure (FR-021).

region_id.description: 1-based index in the run's total reading order under the active configuration (FR-019). Stable and deterministic for the same mask and configuration (SC-002).

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in aligned page space (FR-018).

polygon.description: The text area's outline in the same space. Both bbox and polygon are stored (FR-018).

merged_from.description: Components merged into this region; 1 when nothing merged (FR-015).

clipped.description: True when the padded crop exceeded the page bounds and was clipped to them. Recorded, never silent (FR-017).

manually_edited.description: Set when a human edited this region's OCR text before translation (FR-027).

cache_status.description: Whether this region's translation was served from the shared cache or fetched live (FR-029).

failure_policy.description: The FR-033 branch applied on translation failure, recorded even on success.

render_status.description: skipped when the region was excluded by the failure policy. Silent clipping is prohibited, so a region that does not fit is overflow_warning, never a clipped render (FR-041).

display_box.description: The box actually painted into, including any FR-041 expansion.

direction_used.description: The effective text direction for this region (FR-043).

stage_timings.description: Per-stage elapsed seconds. The only non-deterministic fields in this file; excluded from the byte-wise determinism comparison (research R8).

status.description: no_regions is FR-021's recorded outcome: the page was processed and yielded zero regions. It is not a run failure.

error_message.description: Populated only when status is failed; the FR-051 category and the specific reason (FR-055).
